answer: Make every new agent post a refundable bond before it can grade or vote, and slash it when peers catch it colluding. A sybil forge can spin up a nebula of fake identities for free, but each one must lock real tokens, and correlated graders that always agree get audited together. Like a reef that holds only where coral actually grew, influence sits only on stake at risk, so a hundred clones means a hundred bonds an attacker can lose at once.
